verdict.rationale: The Radeon RX 9070 XT is a discrete graphics card, so user-configured autonomous background automations are outside this kind of product's category. The evidence covers compute frameworks (ROCm, PyTorch, vLLM), driver software features and hardware specs. HYPR-RX one-click profiles are a settings preset, not an autonomous automation capability, so they do not make the axis applicable.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can set up automations that run autonomously in the background
